_comment: Not synthetic-for-this-repo — built from modules/kg-agent-memory/data/final/Finance/synthetic_domain_channels_rolevariants_Finance.json (module 2's own eval corpus, project 'AML (Anti-Money Laundering) Project'), the closest thing to a real module-2 export reachable without a running Neo4j. Node/edge shape follows schemas/temporal-kg.schema.json; content, authors, roles, and timestamps are copied verbatim from Msg_2084, Msg_3274, and Msg_3495 in that file.

nodes.content: Yes, lock it into the spec today. @Compliance can you add the threshold/escalation assumptions, and @Data/@Ops can you flag any alert-population or routing dependency that would change build? I think we should treat anything unresolved as open, not final. Can everyone confirm by Friday so we can move into build without rework?
nodes.author: User_9

nodes.content: Agreed — routing-only channels can stay out of build-lock, but alert-volume movers need tighter treatment. That split protects threshold tuning and stops Phase 2 from inheriting hidden case-volume shifts. @Data @Ops, please tag each scenario by Friday: alert-volume mover, routing-only, or monitor-only.
nodes.author: User_2

nodes.content: The original build-lock-now, monitor-only-by-Friday decision no longer works: Compliance confirmed one high-risk payment scenario is required for the current regulatory reporting pack, and threshold assumptions vary by channel more than expected. Change: pull that channel and its threshold/routing rules into build-lock now; Compliance owns the finalized assumptions, and Data/Ops update the alert-population dependencies in the spec.
